text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Not here... It's not here either...!

While walking down the hallway, I spotted Nishino Flower
frantically searching for something with a pale look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-saaan...
My pendant... my pendant is...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Are you all right? What happened?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu... Air Groove-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... it seems I've lost...
the precious pendant my mother gave me...
choice_data_list: What kind of pendant is it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's the red pendant I was wearing around the chest of my new outfit.
When I checked today, it was gone...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see... Understood.
I'll help search too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't get so flustered. If we search calmly,
we're bound to find it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! ...Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I practiced dancing here in my outfit.
I also feel like I went all the way to the edge of the stage...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Then it might have dropped
toward the stands."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So she passed through here after the stage?
Did she walk near the edge?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Also, while checking the dance choreography,
I was spinning round and round...
Could it have flown off back then...?
choice_data_list: Then, I'll search over by the bushes too.

text_block_list.text:
We searched all over the place after that,
but the pendant was nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. For now,
let's register it as lost property with the student council.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The sun's already setting.
Let's call it for today and search again tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ......No! I will keep searching.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll search everywhere I've been this past month. If I do that, then surely...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Flower...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's my dream...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That pendant has been passed down by mothers for generations, wishing for their children's health.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
From great-grandmother to grandmother.
From grandmother to mother.
From mother to me. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to connect this to the future, too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Just like how Mom entrusted her feelings to me,
I want to pass these inherited feelings
down to the next generation too...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I can't give up!
I will definitely, definitely find that pendant!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Feelings to entrust, huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
However, only until sundown.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Both of you...!
Thank you so much!"

I decided to calm down for a moment
and reflect on recent events.

Recently, I received the photos we took at the church from Beauty Anshinzawa.
...Come to think of it—
choice_data_list: Didn't you go back home the other day?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: "The pendant is over here. You brought your photos and outfit to show me the other day, remember? Are you alright? ...Did something happen?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...No. It's nothing. Thank you.
I'll come pick it up next time...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Found it... It's here...! Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ah, I'm glad.
You managed to safely reclaim your dream.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for causing trouble...!
choice_data_list: I'm glad I got to learn about your secret dream.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The sheer nobility of the feelings passed on to the next generation...
Now that I have witnessed it firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It gave me something to think about as well.
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...! If anything,
I'm the one who should be thanking you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you both so much
for helping me look!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for causing trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"However, it seems when in trouble,
I should have relied on Mother... is that it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I tend to rely on my mother as well.
We should both strive toward independence
as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san as well...?
Fufu, that's so very true.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for causing trouble...!
choice_data_list: It was right under our noses all along, huh.
It was right under our noses all along, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
I got panicked and developed tunnel vision.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Anyone would feel that way. Don't beat yourself up over it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, even in the face of hardship,
you never gave up.
—You did wonderfully, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
! ...Yes!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for causing trouble...!
choice_data_list: It was right under our noses all along, huh.
It was right under our noses all along, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
I need to buckle down and focus even more!

Reaffirming her dream,
Nishino Flower renewed her
determination even further.
